text.setup: Stand tall holding the bar, soft knees, feet hip-width.
cues: Push your hips back and let the bar slide down your thighs.
Keep your back flat — go only as low as your hamstrings allow, usually mid-shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
mistakes: Bending the knees until it becomes a deadlift.
Rounding the back to get lower.
The bar drifting away from your legs.
